header.title: @feugene/fint-i18n Playground
header.description: A focused sandbox for validating runtime behavior, lazy blocks, Vue integration and developer ergonomics.
header.toggleHint: Switch the active locale and observe reactive updates across the page.

basic.title: Reactive `t()` usage
basic.description: Update the name field to verify interpolation and instant locale switching.
basic.escapedHint: Double braces render as literal braces; single braces interpolate the parameter.

directive.title: `v-t`, `v-t.once` and `v-t.preserve`
directive.description: Compare reactive text updates with the one-time and preserve directive variants.
directive.onceHint: This value intentionally does not change after a locale switch.
directive.preserveHint: Keeps the current text while `lab.motto` is missing, then updates reactively once the block loads.

lazy.title: On-demand component scope
lazy.description: Mount the async auth component to load the `auth` translation block only when the UI actually needs it.

partial.title: Deep JSON block loading
partial.description: Load a nested block directly or request the full page bundle and compare the resulting data.

wildcard.title: Load siblings via `widgets.*`
wildcard.description: A single registration `widgets.*` expands into every direct child block (`widgets.alpha`, `widgets.beta`, `widgets.gamma`) and loads them in parallel.
wildcard.buttonHint: Pattern is expanded once, then reused on locale change

fallback.title: `fallbackLocale` and per-call `TranslateOptions`
fallback.description: Missing keys fall back to another locale — globally via the instance `fallbackLocale`, or per call via `t(key, params, { fallbackLocale })`.
fallback.instanceNote: Instance `fallbackLocale: 'en'` resolves EN-only keys when the active locale is RU.
fallback.perCallNote: Per-call `{ fallbackLocale: 'ru' }` resolves RU-only keys when the active locale is EN.

scopeSync.title: `useI18nScopeSync` + `prefix`
scopeSync.description: Load a block without `<Suspense>`. `ready` flips to true once the block arrives; `prefix: true` lets you call keys relative to the block.
scopeSync.prefixNote: Keys below are called as `t('title')` and resolved as `profile.title` thanks to `prefix: true`.

memory.title: Reference counting & manual unload
memory.description: Register usage, load registered blocks with `loadUsedBlocks`, check `isBlockLoaded`, then free memory with `unloadBlock`.
memory.autoNote: Set `unloadUnusedBlocks: true` at init to unload automatically when the usage counter hits zero.

dynamic.title: `addLoaders`, `mergeMessages`, `onError`
dynamic.description: Register brand-new blocks at runtime, inject messages manually, and observe error reporting via hooks.
dynamic.errorHint: A failing loader is reported through the `onError` hook (watch the debug panel) without crashing the app.

plural.title: CLDR forms via `Intl.PluralRules`
plural.description: Drag the counter and switch the locale: English has two forms, Russian has four.
plural.notPluralLabel: Strings that merely contain a pipe
plural.notPluralHint: Plurals are the shape of the value, so no character in a string is special — both lines below are rendered whole.

format.title: `useI18nFormat()` over `Intl`
format.description: Formatters read the locale at call time, so every value re-renders on switch.
format.cacheHint: Formatter instances are cached by locale plus options — building them is the expensive part.
